policy.identity: exact edited source plus relative filename; whitespace/parentheses differences excluded

policy.memory_budget: Oximut sampled soft admission only; Stryker has no matching application cap
policy.ordering: fixture and scenario order reverse each round; incremental/forced order alternates
policy.scope: checked-in deterministic fixtures, including controlled matched arithmetic scaling if selected; no real-project or broad release-performance claim
policy.setup: installation/build excluded; fixture setup duration recorded; cache primes measured separately
policy.stryker_coverage: perTest; worker reuse default; incremental for cache pairs
